background: Aldermore is a UK specialist lender owned by South Africa's FirstRand, funded by online retail and business savings and lending on buy-to-let and owner-occupied mortgages, asset finance and invoice finance, with MotoNovo in motor finance.
synthesis: One of the three main agencies rates the bank, BBB+ on a negative outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 16 Jan 2026. Capital is mixed against UK mid-sized banks: leverage of 8.3% is above the peer median, but CET1 of 13.6% is below it, and since 30 Jun 2023 CET1 has fallen 1.2 points and leverage 0.6 points. Liquidity is the weaker side, with LCR of 170% and NSFR of 129% both below the peer median and LCR down 41 points over the same period (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The item flagged on 30 Sep 2026 is a higher motor finance provision at MotoNovo as buyers circle the bank, which bears on earnings and on who owns it.
